  do j = 1, n
    do i = 1, n
      do k = 1, n
        C(i, j) = C(i, j) + A(i, k) * B(k, j)
      end do
    end do
  end do
end subroutine matmul

pure subroutine matmul(n, A, B, C)
  implicit none
  integer, intent(in) :: n
  real, dimension(:, :), intent(in) :: A, B
  real, dimension(:, :), intent(out) :: C
  integer :: i, j, k

  C = 0

  do j = 1, n
    do k = 1, n
      do i = 1, n
        C(i, j) = C(i, j) + A(i, k) * B(k, j)
      end do
    end do
  end do
end subroutine matmul
